regions.today: Wet and breezy this morning with widespread rain and drizzle along with moderate to strong and gusty south to southeast winds, stronger in the south of the province. The rain will clear for a time during the afternoon, but another spell of rain will move in late this evening. It'll become increasingly windy during the afternoon and evening, with strong and gusty south to southwest winds, reaching gale force on southern coasts. Mild with highest temperatures of 14 to 17 degrees.
regions.tonight: Windy and wet tonight with strong to near gale force and gusty south to southwest winds and gales on southern and southeastern coasts. Rain will clear to blustery showers early on tonight while winds will ease overnight, with moderate to fresh winds, strong on southern coasts. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 10 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Tuesday, will be a blustery day with mostly moderate to fresh west to southwest winds, strong on coasts. There will be a mix of sunshine and scattered showers, some turning heavy with a chance of isolated thunderstorms, though parts of the south and southeast of the province may remain dry. Showers will become isolated later. Winds will ease towards evening. Highest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees.
